title: voices
description: Custom (user-created) voices: the limits per key, the sample rules and the two engines that check and design a voice (docs/design/CONFIG_HOMES.md, C8a). The store directory is a startup setting.

consent_mode.description: optional: accept and check a consent id if one is given. required: refuse a voice without one.

max_voices_per_key.description: Custom voices one API key may hold.

max_consents_per_key.description: Consent recordings one API key may hold.

max_bytes_per_key.description: Bytes of voices and consents one API key may hold.

max_upload_bytes.description: Largest sample or consent recording, in bytes.

min_speech_seconds.description: Least speech a sample must hold, in seconds.

target_seconds.description: The stored reference clip is the best window of about this length, in seconds.

quality_engine.description: The speech engine that makes the speaker-similarity probe after a voice is created. Unset: the probe uses the code's own default engine.

quality_warn_below.description: A similarity below this value is reported as low (cosine).

design_engine.description: The speech engine that renders a voice from a text description. Unset: voice design is not configured.
